name: Fruit Processing Centre
benefit: Pattern of Assistance: Training and DemonstrationType of Assistance: Awareness, Capacity building on fruit and vegetable processing
eligibility_rules: The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.
documents_required: size photographIdentity ProofOther relevant documents as required
how_to_apply:
Mode: Offline Application Process:Step 01: The bonafide farmer can apply/write an application on plain paper.Step 02: Along with the application, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).Step 03: Submit the duly filled and signed application along with the required documents at the nearest office of the Horticulture Development Officer of a CD Block/ Horticulture Circle. Mode of Selection of Beneficiary(s):The bonafide farmers shall be selected on a first come first serve basis. Whom to Contact: 1. District Horticulture Officer
• 2. Assistant Director of Horticulture i/c FP Center
• 3. Horticulture Development Officer
